interpretation.actual_to_monotone_gap: How much current mixed-policy mapping could improve without changing hand ordering.
interpretation.attack_monotone_gap: If large, no monotone function of current pf_rank can represent solver 3bet frequencies; blocker/polar structure is structurally missing.
interpretation.continue_monotone_gap: Residual after best monotone fit indicates current pf_rank ordering mismatch/noise for total defend decisions.
